passages.text: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it, and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Mount Seir. I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolate waste.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He called me “son of man.”
He told me to face Mount Seir.
He told me to prophesy against Mount Seir.
He told me to speak to Mount Seir.
He told me to say, “This is what the Lord GOD says.”
The Lord GOD says, “I am against you, Mount Seir.”
The Lord GOD says, “I will stretch out My hand against you.”
The Lord GOD says, “I will make you a desolate waste.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ עַל־ הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֑יר וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽיו׃ וְאָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַר־ שֵׂעִ֑יר וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ שְׁמָמָ֥ה וּמְשַׁמָּֽה׃

passages.text: I will turn your cities into ruins, and you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Mount Seir.
God says, "I will destroy your cities."
Your cities will become ruins.
You will become a desolation.
You will know that I am the LORD.
passages.original: עָרֶ֙יךָ֙ חָרְבָּ֣ה אָשִׂ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Because you harbored an ancient hatred and delivered the Israelites over to the sword in the time of their disaster at the final stage of their punishment, therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, it will pursue you.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke to Mount Seir.
Mount Seir showed ancient hatred.
Mount Seir handed the Israelites over to the sword.
This happened when Israel faced disaster.
This happened at the time of their punishment’s end.
Therefore, the Lord GOD makes a promise.
The Lord GOD lives forever.
The Lord GOD will give Mount Seir over to bloodshed.
Bloodshed will pursue Mount Seir.
Mount Seir did not hate bloodshed.
Therefore, bloodshed will pursue Mount Seir.
passages.original: יַ֗עַן הֱי֤וֹת לְךָ֙ אֵיבַ֣ת עוֹלָ֔ם וַתַּגֵּ֥ר אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־ יְדֵי־ חָ֑רֶב בְּעֵ֣ת אֵידָ֔ם בְּעֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן קֵֽץ׃ לָכֵ֣ן חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה כִּֽי־ לְדָ֥ם אֶעֶשְׂךָ֖ וְדָ֣ם יִרְדֲּפֶ֑ךָ אִם־ לֹ֥א דָ֛ם שָׂנֵ֖אתָ וְדָ֥ם יִרְדֲּפֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and will cut off from it those who come and go.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Mount Seir.
God will make Mount Seir empty and ruined.
God will make Mount Seir a desolate waste.
God will remove all people who pass through Mount Seir.
No one will come or go from Mount Seir.
passages.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־ הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר לְשִֽׁמְמָ֖ה וּשְׁמָמָ֑ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֹבֵ֥ר וָשָֽׁב׃

passages.text: I will fill its mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Mount Seir.
God will fill its mountains with dead bodies.
People killed by the sword will fall on your hills.
People killed by the sword will fall in your valleys.
People killed by the sword will fall in all your ravines.
passages.original: וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י אֶת־ הָרָ֖יו חֲלָלָ֑יו גִּבְעוֹתֶ֤יךָ וְגֵאוֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ וְכָל־ אֲפִיקֶ֔יךָ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Mount Seir.
God will make Mount Seir a perpetual desolation.
Mount Seir’s cities will not be inhabited.
Then people will know that God is the LORD.
passages.original: שִֽׁמְמ֤וֹת עוֹלָם֙ אֶתֶּנְךָ֔ וְעָרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תֵישַׁבְנָה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Because you have said, ‘These two nations and countries will be ours, and we will possess them,’ even though the LORD was there, therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will treat you according to the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred against them, and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
You said, “These two nations and these two lands will belong to us.”
You said, “We will take them for ourselves.”
But the LORD was present there.
Because you spoke this way, I will act.
I am alive, says the Lord GOD.
I will treat you with the same anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred against them.
I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.
passages.original: יַ֣עַן אֲ֠מָרְךָ אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֨י הַגּוֹיִ֜ם וְאֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֧י הָאֲרָצ֛וֹת לִ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ינָה וִֽירַשְׁנ֑וּהָ וַֽיהוָ֖ה שָׁ֥ם הָיָֽה׃ לָכֵ֣ן חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי כְּאַפְּךָ֙ וּכְקִנְאָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָה מִשִּׂנְאָתֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם וְנוֹדַ֥עְתִּי בָ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶשְׁפְּטֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard every contemptuous word you uttered against the mountains of Israel when you said, ‘They are desolate; they are given to us to devour!’
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD hears everything.
You spoke with contempt against the mountains of Israel.
You said, "They are desolate."
You said, "They are given to us to devour."
The LORD heard every word you said.
You will know that the LORD heard you.
passages.original: וְֽיָדַעְתָּ֮ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי׀ אֶת־ כָּל־ נָאָֽצוֹתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛רְתָּ עַל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֣ר׀ שָׁמֵמָה לָ֥נוּ נִתְּנ֖וּ לְאָכְלָֽה׃

passages.text: You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me. I heard it Myself!
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to Edom.
You used your mouth to boast against Me.
You spoke many words against Me.
I, the Lord, heard everything you said.
passages.original: וַתַּגְדִּ֤ילוּ עָלַי֙ בְּפִיכֶ֔ם וְהַעְתַּרְתֶּ֥ם עָלַ֖י דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD has all power and authority.
The Lord GOD says this to Edom.
The whole earth rejoices now.
But I, the Lord GOD, will make you desolate.
You will become empty and ruined.
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כִּשְׂמֹ֙חַ֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֖ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: As you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel became desolate, so will I do to you. You will become a desolation, O Mount Seir, and so will all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to Edom and Mount Seir.
God saw Edom rejoice when Israel lost its land.
God saw Edom celebrate when Israel became desolate.
God says He will treat Edom the same way.
God will make Mount Seir desolate.
God will make all of Edom desolate.
Then everyone will know that God is the LORD.
passages.original: כְּשִׂמְחָ֨תְךָ֜ לְנַחְלַ֧ת בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁמֵ֖מָה כֵּ֣ן אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֑ךְ שְׁמָמָ֨ה תִֽהְיֶ֤ה הַר־ שֵׂעִיר֙ וְכָל־ אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
